title: Nine Inches of Counting
subtitle: 粉笔与黑板 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 粉笔与黑板（生活与学习·课堂与教具）
meta: 主题语境：粉笔与黑板（生活与学习·课堂与教具）　|　核心词汇：chalk　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chalk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my mother was sent to count ① chalk she could not hold, and she said the counting was the whole of the lesson. The ② chalk, meaning the stick and not the board, was nine inches long and was counted by whoever came last; chalk, she said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chalk in that classroom had the same dust, and the ④ chalk at the end, meaning the one the teacher kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. Chalk, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chalk was the whole of the lesson, meaning the words it left and not the stick. The ⑥ chalk, meaning the words and not any of that, is the only thing in a lesson that everybody copies and nobody questions; chalk, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a stick and the words it leaves. She said the words are the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ chalk had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the dust. The ⑧ chalk of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine inches and eleven years of counting; chalk, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chalk I remember is the one at the end, which was counted in 1968 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ chalk, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being counted; every chalk, she said, is words that have agreed to look like a stick. She said the words were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 粉笔（指那支粉笔本身，与那块黑板相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a chalk 数一支粉笔
D. n. 粉笔（指教室里每一支）
E. n. 粉笔（指末尾那一支）
F. n. 板书（抽象：它留下的那些字）
G. n. 那些字（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chalk, meaning the stick and not the board
chalk was the whole of the lesson
the chalk had become a number in a report
The chalk of the whole thing
A chalk, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: count a chalk 意为“数一支粉笔”，1948 年母亲被派去数她握不住的那支粉笔。
chalk 意为“粉笔”，指那支粉笔本身而不是那块黑板，长九英寸，由最后来的人点数。
chalk 指教室里每一支粉笔，每一支都是同样的粉尘。
chalk 指末尾那一支（老师留下的那一支），是唯一有人认真点数过的。
chalk 意为“板书”，抽象指它留下的那些字，父亲说 chalk 就是那堂课的全部。
chalk 为抽象用法，指那些字本身，是一堂课上人人都抄、却没人质疑的东西。
chalk 意为“粉笔”，到 1963 年这支 chalk 成了报告里的一个数字。
chalk 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸和十一年的点数。
chalk 意为“粉笔”，我记得的是末尾那一支，1968 年数过，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
chalk 为抽象总称，祖母说一支粉笔是唯一会因为被认真点数而变好的东西。
